text:
lucas: FYI FinGov asked for an on-prem POC in an isolated datacenter. Key constraints: fully air-gapped install, weekly patch window only, no outbound telemetry, option to use customer HSM for signing, and metered pricing but with no push telemetry. Any previous playbook we can reuse?

tanya: We did a similar setup for GovEdge last year. Recommend a signed immutable bundle for initial install plus small signed delta bundles for weekly patches. Customer HSM for signature verification is supported if they provide a public key we can include in the bundle trust store.

omar: Important runtime note: our quantized model builds require specific kernel modules on the host for the accelerated runtime (libredwood_rt.so v2). We'll need host kernel file list and exact driver versions. Can provide a compatibility matrix.

lucas: Good call. Also they requested a way to "prove" no telemetry leaves the site for procurement. How do we handle billing/reconciliation?

yvette: Two approaches: 1) commit-based POC price with optional reconciliation later (low friction), or 2) customer-run usage report tool that emits a signed usage manifest they store locally and can upload manually for audit. We can support both; the uploader never initiates outbound connections by default, it's a signed file they push.

mike (legal): From SOW side we need: chain-of-custody language for media (USB/transport), acceptance tests for the POC (activation + inference smoke tests), explicit warranty carveouts for customer-installed host drivers, and a clause about key custody if customer or Redwood holds signing keys. Also check export control if the model weights are restricted.

deploy-bot: build/artifact ready: fin-gov-initial-202403.tar.gz sha256=ab12c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b (signed)

tanya: For cert rotation we propose an offline rotation tool with these steps: 1) operator drops new certs onto a jumpbox, 2) run redwood-offline-rotate --bundle /mnt/usb/new-certs.tar, 3) verifier checks detached signature and applies certs. We'll include a one-page runbook and rollback steps.

omar: Also note: delta minibundles must be signed and include a minimal SBOM and a delta manifest. If customer prohibits any executable outside bundle, we can ship patches as signed container images loaded offline. Need to confirm their allowed install flow.

lucas: Action items: Tanya draft POC BOM + one-pager install/runbook by Wed EOD. Omar produce kernel/driver compatibility matrix + note on quantization caveats by Tue. Mike draft the SOW checklist for chain-of-custody and key custody options. I'll prepare the pricing options (commit vs reconciliation) and propose a POC commitment for procurement.

yvette: Quick note on HSM: if the customer wants to sign activations with their HSM, they can produce a detached signature over the license payload we give. We validate the signature against their public key in the trust store; no key exchange needed. Add this to the BOM.

lucas: Great. I'll sync with the customer Thurs 11am PT and circulate the checklist after. Thanks all.
